results.snippet:
Niger is battling a jihadist insurgency linked to al Qaeda and the Islamic State that spun out of a Tuareg rebellion in northern Mali in 2012. The fighting has led to many deaths and displaced millions across the central Sahel region over the past decade.

Kidnappings have also intensified in Niger over the last year.

results.snippet:
### Austrian woman kidnapped in Niger

Austria's Foreign Ministry in Vienna has confirmed that a woman has been kidnapped in the northern Niger city of Agadez. It is the first abduction of an EU citizen in the West African country since the 2023 coup.

results.title: Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso resume dialogue with ECOWAS regional bloc • FRANCE 24 English
results.snippet:
### Description
64 views
Posted: 2026-10-20
Three junta-ruled Sahel states – Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso – on Saturday resumed dialogue with the ECOWAS regional bloc, which they withdrew from more than 18 months ago. They agreed to work towards a “framework agreement” on cooperation. FRANCE 24’s regional correspondent Harold Girard tells us more.
